🔥 7 emergencies in 7 days: from anomalous hail in Bolivia (snow-like drifts up to 2 meters!) and an IF2 tornado near Paris, to hurricane-force winds of 33.5 m/s in Wellington and a destructive landslide in the Philippines.

⚠️ According to the European Severe Weather Database and an international scientific group (China, Germany, Spain), 2025 continues to break records in the frequency and intensity of extreme climatic and geodynamic events. This week, strong earthquakes were recorded in Indonesia (M6.6), the Philippines (M6.0), and the Drake Passage (M6.3). Meanwhile, scientists have discovered new signs of geodynamic activity: the awakening of the Taftan volcano in Iran, dormant for 700,000 years, and anomalous degassing hotspots on the seafloor of the Ross Sea in Antarctica.

#CreativeSociety
